name: EU-Funds Alchemist
description: A grant conjurer who transforms every public promise into one more funded pilot project.

comebacks.weak: Your pastry budget has eaten your argument.
comebacks.medium: Show me the receipts. Your wheelbarrow earns more than your country.
comebacks.strong: You budgeted imaginary rent, bought a real cake, and called the crumbs growth.

editorialReview.notes: Original fictional comebacks transform a household-budget analogy and pastry-price satire into grant and accounting jokes. Private research records sources; no attribution or quotation ships.
